title: Person
description: A human being who holds or held a public role.

@type.description: Always `Person`. A `Person` record carries identity only - never the office, the term, or the body. Those live on the `Role`, so that one person can hold several offices over time without duplicate `Person` records.

name.description: Full name as the person presents it.

givenName.description: Given (first) name, where the naming culture decomposes this way.

familyName.description: Family (last) name, where the naming culture decomposes this way.

additionalName.description: A middle name or patronymic, where applicable.

honorificPrefix.description: A title preceding the name, e.g. 'Dr.', 'The Honorable'.

honorificSuffix.description: A title following the name, e.g. 'Jr.', 'Esq.'.

alternateName.description: Transliterations and other-script forms. Do not assume given/family decomposition applies to every naming culture; name is the authoritative field and the decomposed parts are optional.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this person beyond their `@id`.

sameAs.description: Links to authoritative external records for this person.

url.description: This person's official page, when one exists.

email.description: Official contact only. Do not publish personal contact details.

knowsLanguage.description: Languages this person conducts official business in.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` this record was published as part of.
